Selected work

Four pages, four problems to solve.

01Personal project · Beauty

Skin Care

A promotional flyer for a beauty and skincare business selling body lotions, facial cleansers, body oils and creams. The brief was a long product list on a page that still felt premium. The amber headline leads, the model's profile points the eye toward the products, and the range sits in a dark panel that can be read in a glance.

Focus
Hierarchy, colour, product presentation
02Event promotion

Creative Connect 2026

An event flyer for Vibes Connect, a meet-up for designers, photographers, videographers and musicians in Benin City. A bold patterned frame carries the energy, a chunky title does the shouting, and the date, time and venue sit in colour blocks at the bottom so nobody misses them. Created in Photoshop to build awareness before the event on 17 October 2026.

Tool
Photoshop
03Personal practice · Fashion

Benji's Fashion

A practice concept for an agbada and native wear business. Purple was the starting decision: deep enough to feel rich, quiet enough to let embroidery detail do the selling. Oval frames pull two outfits out for a closer look, and the services list stays tidy beside the hero garments.

Tool
Photoshop
Focus
Colour, detail, audience
04Food · Promotional flyer

Gifty's Cuisine

Food flyers live or die on appetite. A deep green background makes the orange jollof tray glow, a wheel of sides shows the range without extra text, and the delivery badge, menu, phone number and address are easy to find at the bottom.

Focus
Food photography, menu layout

Design in motion

Then I make them move.

Flyer animations and motion graphics. They play quietly as you scroll to them; use the controls for the full video with sound.

About

Looking good is the easy part.

I'm Tobi, a graphic designer in Lagos with over a year of working experience. I make promotional graphics, social media campaigns, marketing materials and brand identities, and I animate them when the idea needs it.

I've designed for fashion, logistics, technology, food, finance, healthcare, beauty and creative events. Every brief teaches me to ask the same questions first: who is this for, and what should they remember? Then composition, typography and colour have a job to do.

I'm still growing, and I like it that way. I follow brand guidelines closely, I notice small details, and I'm happiest when a static design gets a second life in After Effects.
